Definition: a Calebite or descendant of Caleb
BiblicalUsage: Kalibbow is a Calebite — a descendant of Caleb. Nabal, the churlish rich man of Carmel who refused David bread, was a Calebite, of the house of Caleb.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the word is a quiet irony: the descendant of the man who wholly followed the LORD would not follow Him at all, and a good name does not make a good man.
